policy: Unverified leads only. Never shown on verdict cards; never changes A–D grades, nutrient values or safe amounts. Absence of reported harm is not evidence of safety. Counts are not incidence or consensus.

collection.query: taxon Testudinidae (40019) with observation field "Eating" (id 13) or "Eating: (Interaction)"; all quality grades
collection.requests: about 25 API calls at ~1 request/second with an identifying User-Agent
collection.privacy: no user names, profile data, photos, coordinates or free-text descriptions stored; region kept at the coarsest place_guess token
collection.notes: No Testudo (Mediterranean tortoise) observation carried an eating field at retrieval time.

feeding inferred from observer annotation/photo
plant identity may be casual or needs_id grade
wild foraging does not establish captive feeding safety or frequency
